'''Bab-Udun''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was stationed on [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]] during the [[Invasion of Manaan]]. He was a cybertech specialist.<ref name="Encounter">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=location|Joint Operations Base|Manaan}}</ref>
